I gave Runway multiple chances because I wanted it to work, but my experience has been extremely frustrating and expensive.  
  
My biggest problem with Runway is the credit system combined with inconsistent results. You can give it a clear image and specific instructions for a relatively simple animation, and it can produce something that completely misses what you asked for. The problem is that you still burn credits on the failed attempt. Then you change the prompt, try again, spend more credits, and hope the next generation gets it right. Extremely disappointing for the price  
  
I purchased a yearly Runway subscription expecting to be able to create realistic, usable AI videos. After spending a significant amount of time and credits trying different prompts, reference images, and video concepts, the results have been consistently disappointing.  
  
Even fairly straightforward concepts produced videos with unrealistic movement, inconsistent objects, strange details, and results that were nowhere near usable for professional social media content. I also had generations fail during processing, which made the experience even more frustrating.

## Extremely Disappointing – Costly Errors, No Accountability
I had a very frustrating experience with RunwayML and would strongly caution others before using their platform.  
  
The service consistently failed to deliver what it promises. While it gives the impression that the next generation will improve results, in reality it repeatedly produces incorrect outputs—costing you more credits each time.  
  
In my case, I clearly specified that the project was for Instagram Reels (9:16 format). Despite this, the system generated all videos in 16:9 landscape. This fundamental error forced me to regenerate everything at my own cost. The AI agent even acknowledged the mistake.  
  
The issues didn’t stop there:  
  
Incorrect images were generated multiple times despite clear instructions [...] My final experience with customer support was particularly frustrating. I spent more than two hours working with the help desk trying to add a voice to a video. Throughout the conversation, I repeatedly explained that I did not want instructions on how to edit the video myself. I wanted the AI to regenerate the scene correctly. Instead, support continued to walk me through the editing steps. Some of the instructions were incomplete or incorrect, and there was no clear step-by-step guidance. Rather than resolving the underlying generation issue, the conversation focused on workarounds that did not address the problem. [...] Character consistency was another major problem. I wrote prompts requiring two specific individuals in the same room. Instead, Runway frequently removed one character, substituted an entirely different person, or repeatedly inserted the wrong character despite using reference assets. Maintaining continuity for recurring characters proved extremely difficult.  
I also encountered problems with image references. Some reference images were locked for more than two weeks after being generated incorrectly. Even more frustrating, Runway sometimes rejected AI-generated images that had originally been created within its own platform, preventing me from using them as reference assets.

results.content:
The credit system makes an already frustrating experience feel extremely unfair. You can spend a significant amount of money very quickly while repeatedly trying to fix basic errors.  
  
My advice: be extremely careful before buying credits. Understand that every failed generation and every attempt to correct it can cost you hundreds more credits.  
  
Based on my experience, I will not be using RunwayML again. [...] ## If I could give RunwayML zero stars
If I could give RunwayML zero stars, I would.  
  
I’ve made a few videos using the platform, and the experience has been incredibly frustrating. It repeatedly makes very simple mistakes, even when the instructions are clear. You then ask it to correct the mistake, it charges another 750 credits, and very often it makes exactly the same mistake again. You try again — another 750 credits gone. Before long, you have burned through your credits trying to get Runway to fix errors that should never have happened in the first place. [...] My complaint is not simply about the quality of the generated video. It is about the automatic consumption of all my newly purchased credits without prior approval, followed by the refusal to refund the payment.   
  
I believe users should have meaningful control over credit consumption, especially when an AI system recommends a paid upgrade and then automatically initiates multiple costly operations.  
  
Based on this experience, I cannot recommend Runway to users who need predictable credit usage, transparent billing and reliable customer support.
